# VIctory fork for AMD Radeon (work in progress)

This is a fork of [VIctory](https://github.com/Marvisak/VIctory) by Marvisak
and its contributors. It follows upstream `main` up to `8e79c80` (2026-11-24),
carries a number of upstream pull requests, and adds fixes found while running
the game's world on one AMD card.

**This repository contains no game files, code or assets.** You need your own
copy of the game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's
developer or publisher.

## State of this fork (2026-11-25)

**Not playable yet: 5 to 7 frames per second.** Tested on one machine only:
Windows 11, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16 GB, Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 64 GB RAM, Series X
profile. Nothing here has been run on an NVIDIA or Intel card.

| What | State on that machine |
|------|-----------------------|
| Boot, menus | work, 30 fps (as upstream) |
| The world | renders lit, with textures, people, vehicles, vegetation, water and sky |
| Saves | load and store |
| Frame rate in the world | 5 to 7 fps (5.4 to 6.7 standing still in a scene of 8,400 draws; less while driving) |
| Light in shadow | a constant, less of it in creases and under objects: the game's ray-traced indirect light does not run. One level does not suit every hour (see the known problems) |
| Reflections | the game's, held down: without rays every glossy surface reflected the open sky, indoors too, and floors looked whitewashed |
| Shadows of the sun and of lamps | the game's own, and they work; too much of the constant light drowns them |
| Distant trees | drawn |
| Vehicles in motion | whole (they lost and stretched parts until the copies of title memory saw writes through every view of a page) |
| In-game phone | **broken**: with the phone out the world is unlit (black) and the phone is an empty outline |
| Memory | about 22 GB of RAM and more video memory than a 16 GB card has |

A driver timeout (Windows resets the display driver, every monitor goes black
for a moment) happened once in the session this was written in. Expect it.

### What this fork changes over upstream

Picture:
- The world's indirect diffuse light is replaced by a constant while the ray
  passes do not run. What the game's resolve pass left instead was bright
  magenta on leaves, cloth and paper, and blocks of colours indoors
  (`VICTORY_AMBIENT=<level>`, 0.6 by default; `off` keeps the game's output).
  Its colour can be set (`VICTORY_AMBIENT_TINT=r,g,b`), and less of it
  reaches creases, corners and the underside of things, worked out from the
  scene's depth alone (`VICTORY_AMBIENT_SHADE=strength,radius`; grainy, it is
  not blurred yet). In diagnostics builds all of it can be tuned in a running
  game from a file (`VICTORY_AMBIENT_FILE`).
- The game's reflections are held to a part of that constant light after
  its last reflection pass (`VICTORY_AMBIENT_REFLECT`, 0.5 by default, 0
  leaves them alone). Without rays they are the sky's, unoccluded.
- Blending is off on integer render targets in host pipelines: the console
  ignores it there, D3D12 refuses the pipeline. One world pipeline the driver
  refused at every launch is made now (pull request #45, pgm1207 and Arvi23).
- In pixel shaders every read of another pixel of the same 2x2 quad goes
  through quad reads, helper pixels included. Wave reads return 0 from helper
  pixels on AMD, which showed as lines along every triangle on car paint,
  glass and skin. Upstream does this after discards only.
- A helper pixel's `v_readfirstlane` reads its own value (upstream `0601955`).
- Twice the dynamic descriptor slots, so the tables of heavy frames fit.
- Depth and stencil twins for depth textures written by compute, screen
  passes with pipeline workers of their own, textures told apart by the mips
  their memory really holds, and other fixes listed in the history.

Speed:
- The clamps of a run of indirect draws are recorded in a list before the
  list that draws, and run one after another (`VICTORY_HOIST_CLAMPS`, 7 by
  default, 0 for each before its draw): 225 to about 80 ms of GPU time per
  frame in a scene of 9,000 draws.
- The snapshots and the copy-back of the tiles shaders write are taken on
  several threads (pull request #18, PikPakPik): copying back went from
  about 43 to about 33 ms a frame here. The frame rate did not move.
- The title's submissions return before the host GPU is done, with what
  they owe finished at the next wait (`VICTORY_ASYNC_SUBMIT=0` turns it
  off): 200-238 to 150-186 ms a frame in the same place. It gained nothing
  until the next two changes were in.
- Title memory the game shows one 64 KiB view at a time is used in place:
  its pages follow one another in their section, so the stretch is mapped
  once more at an address of ours and the host heap opened there
  (`VICTORY_STRETCH=0` turns it off). Copying back went from 36 to 12 ms a
  frame. Ranges made of several stretches are still copied.
- The table of descriptor views is a read-write lock. A PIX timing capture
  showed the game's five recording threads taking turns on it as a mutex,
  6,600 context switches a second each.
- Thin LTO and one codegen unit for the release profile (pull request #96,
  Key-rs), and eight changes by romainhedouin that take repeated work out
  of the draw path (#24, #25, #27, #28, #29, #30, #33, #34). None of the
  eight moved the frame time measurably here; nothing broke.
- What a frame still waits for, from the same capture: the thread that
  submits, which prepares each batch while the host GPU is idle (the plan
  of directly indexed descriptors walks every slot, `bindless_plan`), and
  copies of title memory, about 100 MB a frame.
- Shader cache entries of another build can be reused
  (`VICTORY_SHADER_BUILD_OF=<executable>`, diagnostics).

Memory the title shows at several addresses:
- Every view of a guarded physical page is guarded with it, so a write of
  the title's through another address is seen (the idea of victory-fork
  #115 and victory-amd, written anew here); blocks the kernel is about to
  write stay writable for two seconds. Before this, parts of moving
  vehicles were left behind; the distant trees' quads that crossed the
  screen have not come back since either (cause not proven).

AMD:
- Shaders that crash or never leave the AMD driver's compiler cost only
  their pipeline, not the run.
- Buffer element counts come from the host's own table, not a size query the
  driver's compiler crashes on.

Lifetimes: a list keeps the copies of title memory whose addresses it gives
as root views, and objects the title let go of are kept eight seconds at
least (32 presented frames were a third of a second in the menus).

Diagnostics: every translated shader is logged with its DXIL hash, the one
[Radeon GPU Detective](https://gpuopen.com/radeon-gpu-detective/) names a
shader in flight by, so its crash reports can be matched to the game's
programs. Diagnostics builds: `VICTORY_SHADER_PATCH` changes one word of a
shader's machine code before translation, `VICTORY_SHADER_SWAP` replaces
shader containers by files, `VICTORY_ALWAYS_COPY=1` refreshes every copy of
title memory each frame, `VICTORY_GPU_TIMING=1` logs GPU time per pipeline.
Each is described in a comment where it is read.

### How it is run here

A diagnostics build (`cargo build --profile diag -p victory --features
diagnostics`), with:

```
VICTORY_PRESENT_TARGET=1x1:1
VICTORY_HAIR=1
victory run <game_scarlett_master.exe> --execute --console series-x
```

The first launch after a build translates every shader and builds about
2,500 pipelines; the loading screen can stay frozen, with sound, for minutes.

### Known problems

- With the in-game phone out the world is unlit (see the table).
- The per-draw descriptor slots are few for the heaviest places: when they
  run out, some draws of a frame are dropped.
- Memory: the process commits about 33 GB after a quarter of an hour's
  drive (the title's own 7 GB, 8 GB of textures on the card, copies of its
  buffers, and the system's backing of video memory).
- No ray-traced light; the constant that stands in for it is the same
  everywhere and at every hour. The default of 0.6 is too much at night (it
  fills the shadows the game's lamps cast and the picture goes flat) and too
  little at noon (what the sun does not reach is nearly black). Levels that
  looked right on this machine: 0.07 bluish at night, 0.3 warm at dusk and
  dawn, 1.4 sky blue at noon. Making it follow the game's sky is being
  worked on.
- Some compute programs do not translate (ray-tracing structure builders,
  wind volumes, a few others) and their passes are dropped. With
  `VICTORY_RAYS=1` the builders translate and run, and the device is
  removed a minute and a half later: do not expect light from it. Two
  causes found with AMD's Radeon GPU Detective are fixed (lists and
  descriptors named copies of title memory that were already destroyed);
  the run now ends on a read at an address no resource ever had.
- About 380 draws of a frame are dropped in the world for want of a host
  pipeline: programs that do not translate, and six pipelines the AMD driver
  refuses (two compute, four mesh). Which of the two costs most is not
  measured.
- Windows 10 is reported not to get past start-up without a newer D3D12
  runtime (issue #9, pull request #44, not merged or tried here yet); this
  fork has only been run on Windows 11.
- Tests that fail on this machine, before and after this update:
  `list::tests::lists_are_cut_at_waits_that_follow_work` in `victory-gpu`
  and five `xmem` tests in `victory-hle` (issues #2 and #8).
- `crates/victory-shader/src/emit/lower.rs` is larger than the size limit of
  `cargo xtask policy`; it is source code, not an asset.
- Many changes are specific to this title and this GPU, and some are marked
  `shortcut:` in the code where they approximate what the console does.

# VIctory

Runs Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series X|S) natively on Windows, from files
the user supplies.

The title's x86-64 code runs unchanged inside our process; VIctory supplies
the platform underneath it and converts the title's data, ahead of time where
it can and on first use where it must (shaders). See
[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

## Getting started

Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, a CPU with AVX2, a Direct3D 12 GPU with
shader model 6.6 (and mesh shaders for the world), Rust (pinned in
`rust-toolchain.toml`).

The title also needs several GiB of available Windows commit at startup.
Check **Committed** under **Task Manager → Performance → Memory**. If
`crashes.log` reports Windows error 1455, close other applications or increase
the Windows paging file size, then retry.

```powershell
cargo xtask install-hooks                # asset-policy check on every commit
copy victory.example.toml victory.toml   # then set your paths (outside the repo)
cargo test --workspace                   # needs no game data
cargo run -p victory -- config           # check your paths
```

Run the title:

```powershell
cargo build --release -p victory
target\release\victory.exe run <game dir>\<the title's exe> --execute
```

The window caption shows the framerate. Saves, settings and `crashes.log`
are kept under the data folder (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\victory\data`), derived
data under the cache folder.

Input: XInput pads. A DualSense or DualSense Edge (USB or Bluetooth) is read
over HID as well and plays as the first pad when no XInput pad answers. With
no pad connected the keyboard is a pad while the title's window has focus:

| Keys | Pad |
|------|-----|
| W A S D / I J K L | left / right stick |
| arrows | D-pad |
| Enter, O | A, B |
| Backspace, X, Y | B, X, Y |
| Q / E, Z / C | shoulders, triggers |
| F / H | stick clicks |
| Esc, Tab | Menu, View |

## Commands

```
victory inspect <exe|dll> [--imports] [--exports]
victory census [paths...] [--missing] [--strict]
victory lib-exports <import.lib> [--list]
victory shader-info [paths...] [--verbose] [--disasm]
victory translate [paths...] [--validate] [--pipelines] [--list] [--jobs N]
victory run <exe> [--execute] [--unimplemented trap|zero] [--strict]
            [--console series-x|series-s] [-- <title arguments>]
victory config
```

Logging: `VICTORY_LOG=victory_loader=trace,info` (a release build logs
info and above).

## Debugging

A release build has no debugging aids. Build them in with

```powershell
cargo build --profile diag -p victory --features diagnostics   # target\diag\victory.exe
```

| Variable | Effect |
|----------|--------|
| `VICTORY_LOG=<target>=debug,...` | debug and trace output |
| `VICTORY_STACKS=20,60` | every thread's stack at those seconds |
| `VICTORY_WATCH=<rva>,...` | logs a title u32 when it changes |
| `VICTORY_KEYS=30:Enter,35:X` | presses keys at those seconds, focus or not |
| `VICTORY_CRASH_BREAKPOINTS=1` | appends first-chance breakpoints to `crashes.log`, including ones a handler may recover from |
| `VICTORY_CRASH_SAVE=<rva>:<len>,...` | saves title memory to the cache folder on a crash |
| `VICTORY_CAPTURE=<dir>` | saves presented frames (powers of two, or `VICTORY_CAPTURE_FRAMES=<list>`) |
| `VICTORY_DUMP_TARGETS=1` | with the two above, saves every render target of those frames |
| `VICTORY_D3D12_DEBUG=1` | host debug layer |
| `VICTORY_D3D12_GBV=1` | with the above, GPU-based validation (bad descriptor use reported, not faulted; slow) |
| `VICTORY_D3D12_DRED=1` | on a GPU failure, the allocation hit and the commands in flight |
| `VICTORY_SKIP_PIPELINES=<hash>,...` | omit draws and dispatches, including indirect ones, whose pipeline contains a listed 16-digit shader hash |
| `VICTORY_GPU_TIMING=1` | with the above, each list of a submission run and timed on its own; slow lists logged with their slowest commands |
| `VICTORY_D3D12_WARP=1` | host device on the software adapter (slow; cannot reset the driver) |
| `VICTORY_SHADER_LOOP_LIMIT=<n>` | translated shader loops stop after `n` iterations per lane instead of 2^20 (own shader cache entries); if a lower `n` makes world frames much faster, loops hitting the limit are what makes them slow |
| `VICTORY_AUDIO_CAPTURE=<file.wav>` | records what the title plays (our process only) |
| `VICTORY_XMA_DUMP=<dir>` | saves the first 32 XMA voices' context and input |

Every build appends unhandled exceptions, panics, and host GPU failures to
`crashes.log` in the title's data folder.

For a startup breakpoint (`0x80000003`), run the diagnostics build with
`VICTORY_CRASH_BREAKPOINTS=1`. Keep the console output along with the new
`crashes.log` entries. A host DLL refusal includes the caller stack in the
console output. The refusal is expected for DLLs outside the host policy,
including `rpcrt4.dll`.

On Series 1.0.2.1, a missing `appdata0.rpf` reproduced the breakpoint at
`+0x2237178` before the first window. Restore the archive from the same
package beside the title executable. `run --execute` checks that it can
read the RPF9 header before starting this build.

To compare hardware and software rendering, repeat with
`VICTORY_D3D12_WARP=1` and check the console for
`host device on the software adapter (WARP)` to confirm the WARP device was
created. Compare the exception's module and offset, stack frames, and
preceding messages across the two runs.

Orca

中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português · Türkçe · Русский

Bots inside your agent IDE.

Open source. Bring your own everything: your Claude Code or Codex, your local or remote machines, your tools. Ask from Slack or your phone. When it needs you, it's one tab away.

Download Orca  ·  Explore bots →

## Features
### Orca Bots Ask a bot in Slack, Linear, or GitHub to fix a bug, and come back to a tested pull request. It runs on your own Claude Code or Codex. Open its work in Orca to review it or step in. [Overview](https://orca.dev/bots) · [Security](https://orca.dev/docs/bots/security) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/bots)
### Chat or Terminal Run any agent in Chat UI or as the raw CLI, and move a conversation between the two without losing context. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/native-chat)
### Orchestrate Agents Hand a big task to one agent. It splits the work, starts worker agents in their own workspaces, and brings their results back to you. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/orchestration)
### Run Anywhere Pair a Remote Orca Server, work on any SSH host, or give a worktree its own cloud VM. Your agents keep running when your laptop sleeps. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/ways-to-run)
### Mobile App Pair Orca with the mobile app to get pinged when an agent needs you, reply in chat, and keep work moving on any of your machines when you are away from your desk. [iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app) · [Android APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/mobile)
### Review AI Output Review diffs, leave notes on exact changed lines, and send focused feedback back to an agent. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/annotate-ai-diff)
### Git Integration Draft commit messages and pull requests from the diff, then send failing checks or PR review comments back to an agent to fix. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/commit-push)
### Parallel Worktrees Quickly split tasks into isolated environments, so multiple agents can work side by side without interfering with each other. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/model/worktrees)
### Design Mode Click any element in Orca's browser to copy its HTML, styles, and selector, then paste it into your agent's chat. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/browser/design-mode)
### GitHub & Linear, Native See your GitHub and Linear tasks in one place, and start a workspace for each when you're ready to build. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/linear)
### Orca CLI Anything you can do in Orca, your agents can do too: create worktrees, start workers, drive the browser and desktop apps, and schedule automations, all from the command line. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/overview)
### Plugins Themes, editors, languages, and panels from the community, installed in a click. [Browse plugins →](https://orca.dev/plugins)
### Split Anything Put agents, terminals, browsers, and diffs side by side in split panes shaped to the task. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/model/tabs-panes-splits)
**Also in the box:** - **[Bot Schedules & Triggers](https://orca.dev/docs/bots#put-it-on-a-schedule)**: run a bot every weekday at 9, or when a pull request opens, a check fails, or a webhook fires. - **[Bot Memory in Markdown](https://orca.dev/docs/bots/security#what-you-can-review)**: a bot's soul and memory are plain Markdown files (`SOUL.md`, `MEMORY.md`) you can read and edit. - **[Drag Files to Agents](https://orca.dev/docs/editing/file-explorer)**: drag files from the explorer, or images from your desktop, straight into an agent's prompt. - **[Jump Anywhere](https://orca.dev/docs/model/quick-open)**: one shortcut jumps to any workspace or tab across every repo and host. - **[Rich Previews](https://orca.dev/docs/editing/viewers)**: open images, PDFs, and Markdown right in the workspace, next to the agent that made them. - **[Mobile Emulator](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/overview#mobile-emulator)**: run an iOS Simulator or Android emulator beside your agent, and let it tap, type, and check its own work. - **[Dictation](https://orca.dev/docs/settings#voice)**: press a shortcut and talk. Orca types what you say into the agent's prompt or terminal. - **[Usage & Accounts](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/usage-tracking)**: see how much of your agent limits you've used and when they reset, and switch accounts without logging out. - **[Automations](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/automations)**: schedule prompts to run on any repo: nightly dependency bumps, weekly triage, flaky-test sweeps. - **[Computer Use](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/computer-use)**: when there's no CLI or API, agents can see and drive desktop apps and external browsers. - **And many, many more**: we ship daily, so this list is perpetually behind. The [changelog](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) is the real feature list. --- ## Supported Agents Works with **any CLI agent** — if it runs in a terminal, it runs in Orca.

Claude Code   Codex   Grok   Cursor   GitHub Copilot   Muse   DeepSeek Harness   ZCode   OpenCode   MiMo Code   Amp   OpenClaude   Antigravity   Pi   oh-my-pi   Hermes Agent   Devin   Goose   Auggie   Autohand Code   Charm   Cline   CodeBuddy   Codebuff   Freebuff   Command Code   Continue   Droid   Kilocode   Kimi   Kiro   Mistral Vibe   Qwen Code   Rovo Dev   + any CLI agent

--- ## Install ### Desktop — macOS, Windows, Linux - **[Download from orca.dev](https://orca.dev/download)** - Or grab a build directly: [macOS Apple Silicon](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-arm64.dmg) · [macOS Intel](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-x64.dmg) · [Windows (.exe)](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-windows-setup.exe) · [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-linux.AppImage) · [All builds](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest) _Or via a package manager:_ ```bash # macOS (Homebrew) # Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask. brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Upgrade an existing install brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first) brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc # Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source yay -S stably-orca-bin ``` ### Mobile App — iOS, Android Pair with your desktop app to monitor and steer your agents from your phone. - **iOS:** [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) - **Android:** [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app) · [Download APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Install guide](https://orca.dev/docs/android-apk) --- ## Community & Support - **Discord:** Join the community on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/fzjDKHxv8Q)**. - **Twitter / X:** Follow **[@orca_build](https://x.com/orca_build)** for updates and announcements. - **WeChat:** Scan to join an Orca community WeChat group. - **Feedback & Ideas:** We ship fast. Missing something? [Request a new feature](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/issues). - **Privacy:** See the [privacy & telemetry docs](https://orca.dev/docs/telemetry) for what anonymous usage data Orca collects and how to opt out. - **Show Support:** [Star](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) this repo to follow along with our daily ships. --- ## Developing Want to contribute or run locally? See our [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.

## Signed Builds Windows code signing sponsored/provided by [SignPath.io](https://signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). ## License Orca is free and open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

T3 Code

The open-source control plane for coding agents.

Download · iOS · Android · Web · Docs · Discord

T3 Code runs the coding agents on your machine and gives them one fast interface. Start a thread at your desk, then approve the next step from your phone. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build, Antigravity, Kiro, Pi, Muse Code, fx, and any [ACP](./docs/user/providers-acp.md) agent. If an agent is set up on your computer, T3 Code can control it. ## What you get - **Your subscriptions.** T3 Code does not resell tokens. It drives the agents you are already signed in to. - **Every agent in one place.** Change models in the middle of a thread. Let Claude hand a task to Codex. - **Desktop, web, and phone.** One server, and every client shows the same threads. There are apps for iOS and Android. - **Remote ready.** Run agents on any machine. Connect over your local network, Tailscale, or [T3 Connect](./docs/user/remote-access.md). - **Git built in.** Each thread can work in its own worktree. Review the diff, then commit, push, and open a pull request with one button. - **Fast.** Performance is a feature here. We measure it, and we treat a dropped frame as a bug. - **Open.** Source code is MIT licensed. If you don't like something, fork it under your own branding (see [Trademarks and forks](#trademarks-and-forks)). ## Install ### Desktop app [Download T3 Code](https://t3.codes/download) for macOS, Windows, or Linux. You can also use a package manager: | Platform | Command | | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | | macOS | `brew install --cask t3-code` | | Windows | `winget install T3Tools.T3Code` or `scoop install extras/t3code` | | Arch Linux | `yay -S t3code-bin` | | Nix | `nix profile add github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable#t3code` | | Debian, Ubuntu | `.deb` from [Releases](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/releases) | ### Command line This installs the `t3` command. Run `t3` to start the server and open the web app. ```bash curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh ``` On Windows, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://t3.codes/install.ps1 | iex ``` To try it once without an install, run `npx t3@latest`. ### Phone Get the app from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/t3-code-remote-claude-more/id6787819824) or [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3tools.t3code). Then follow [remote access](./docs/user/remote-access.md) to connect it to your computer. ### Sign in to an agent T3 Code needs one agent that is installed and signed in. For example, install [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) and run `claude auth login`, or install [Codex CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli) and run `codex login`. [Provider setup](./docs/user/install.md#providers) has the steps for each agent. [Install T3 Code](./docs/user/install.md) covers nightly builds, AppImage, WSL, and NixOS. ## "Wait, what are you selling me?" Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar. We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork the source code and build the tool that you want, under your own name and branding. ## Documentation - [Install and first run](./docs/user/install.md) - [Remote access from a phone or another machine](./docs/user/remote-access.md) - [Permission modes](./docs/user/permission-modes.md) - [Source control](./docs/user/source-control.md) - [Connect outside agents over MCP](./docs/user/outside-agents.md) - [FAQ](./docs/user/faq.md) [All docs](./docs/README.md) has the full list. ## Contributing We have limited review capacity. Small, focused fixes are the most likely to be merged. Features need an approved discussion first. - Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before you report a bug or open a pull request. - Put feature requests in [Ideas](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/discussions/categories/ideas). - Build from source with the [development runbook](./docs/operations/00_development.md#first-checkout). The [architecture overview](./docs/internals/01_architecture.md) explains how it works. - Get help in [Discord](https://discord.gg/jn4EGJjrvv). ## License The source code in this repository is licensed under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). ## Trademarks and forks The MIT license applies **only to the source code**. It does not grant any rights to T3 Tools, Inc.'s trademarks, branding, or trade dress, including the **T3 Code** name, wordmark, logos, and application icons. If you fork, redistribute, or build on T3 Code's source code: - **Use your own branding.** Replace the T3 Code name, wordmark, logos, and application icons in any public fork, redistributed build, website, package, or app store listing. - **Be explicitly clear that your project is unofficial.** Do not use the T3 Code name, wordmark, logo, or branding in your own projects without making it unmistakably clear that your project is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by T3 Tools, Inc. Using our name, wordmark, logo, or branding in a way that suggests official status or affiliation is trademark infringement and unlawful. **Any project indicating or implying that it is an official version of T3 Code when it is not will be pursued to the full extent of the law.** See [TRADEMARK.md](./TRADEMARK.md) for the full trademark and branding policy.

VoiceStudio

AI voice studio. On your device.

Clone, design, dub, dictate, transcribe and narrate in 646 languages.

Runs on your laptop, desktop, servers, phone, tablets and more

Website · Download · Get started · Docs · VoiceStudio Pro · VoiceStudio Cloud

🇬🇧 English · 🇨🇳 简体中文 · 🇯🇵 日本語 · 🇰🇷 한국어 · 🇷🇺 Русский · 🇸🇦 العربية · 🇩🇪 Deutsch · 🇪🇸 Español · 🇫🇷 Français · 🇮🇳 हिन्दी
🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia · 🇮🇹 Italiano · 🇳🇱 Nederlands · 🇵🇱 Polski · 🇵🇹 Português · 🇹🇭 ไทย · 🇹🇷 Türkçe · 🇹🇼 繁體中文 · 🇺🇦 Українська · 🇻🇳 Tiếng Việt

Strategic sponsors    ·   Special sponsor 



Demo workspace · Default dark theme · Watch the HD tour

## What you can do

Voice cloning
Turn a clean reference recording into speech in a familiar voice.
Video dubbing
Translate and dub videos with speech timed to the original.

Voice design
Describe a voice in words and generate it.
Local models
Choose your engines and download only the models you need.
More screenshots

Workspace overview
Model packs
- **Dictate & transcribe** — A floating dictation widget and local transcription - **Narrate & batch** — Stories, audiobooks and queued jobs - **Connect & automate** — Local API, MCP, reusable recipes and watch folders Start with **VoiceStudio** (default, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice), or pick from dozens of other engines in the Model Manager. See the [features & engine catalog](docs/feature-catalog.md).

## Pro and Cloud Everything above is free, runs on your own hardware and needs no account. Pro and Cloud are optional.
  VoiceStudio Pro

For paid client work across more than one machine.
  • A Commercial License for VoiceStudio's code in your client work, emailed to you
  • One user on up to 3 devices at once
  • Send jobs to your other GPUs while your projects stay local
  • New features and fixes first
Closed-source build, account required, 7-day full refund. The AGPL-3.0 app stays free, including commercial use under its terms. Neither licence covers model weights: the default OmniVoice weights are non-commercial (CC-BY-NC), so check each model's licence in the Model Manager before client work.

See Pro plans → 		  VoiceStudio Cloud

A hosted voice and dubbing API, coming soon. No GPU needed.
  • Speech, voice design and voice cloning with consent
  • Dubbing, transcription and audiobooks
  • Usage and credits by day or project
  • Long jobs that run on their own
Not available yet: join early access for free usage credits. The desktop app stays free and local.

Join Cloud early access →
## Platforms Experimental [Windows ROCm setup](docs/install/windows-rocm.md) supports selected RDNA 2 RX 6000 GPUs with targets `gfx1030`, `gfx1031` or `gfx1032`; RX 6500 XT (`gfx1034`) is excluded. GPU transcription uses a CTranslate2 build with native `gfx1031` kernels that this repository builds from upstream source and pins by hash, and setup checks actual GPU kernel execution. RX 6700 XT tests also cover native Torch speech generation and PyTorch Whisper. ROCm 10 faster-whisper uses a separate inference process to preserve safe CPU selection and fallback. Other cards and workloads retain the qualification limits in the guide. Performance presets validate changed engine selections in an offline child process before saving them, preserving fallback when an installed runtime fails. Choose your system, then expand an installation method. Native GGUF engines additionally support engine-specific Vulkan acceleration on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs ([OmniVoice](docs/engines/omnivoice-gguf.md#vulkan-acceleration), [CosyVoice](docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)). OmniVoice GGUF selects its GPU and model size automatically on Windows and Linux. Vulkan discovery retries a stalled hidden probe with a native summary; Windows and Linux desktop builds fail rather than silently ship without their Vulkan module.
macOS · Homebrew · DMG · installer
**Stable · Apple Silicon**
macOS 13.3+ · Apple Silicon: local engines with Metal (MPS). ```sh brew tap debpalash/tap brew trust --cask debpalash/tap/voicestudio brew install --cask debpalash/tap/voicestudio ```
DMG Download the DMG for your Mac, open it and drag VoiceStudio into Applications. [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/install/macos.md)
One-command installer ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ```
Intel Mac · remote backend · Limited The app UI runs on Intel; connect it to a VoiceStudio backend on another computer. [Guide](docs/install/macos.md)
> [!NOTE] > On macOS, "VoiceStudio is damaged and can't be opened" means Gatekeeper blocked the app, not that the download is broken. See the [Gatekeeper fix](docs/install/macos.md#gatekeeper-quarantine).
Windows · PowerShell · EXE
**Stable · x64**
Windows 10/11 x64 · NVIDIA CUDA · AMD ROCm (opt-in) · CPU. ```powershell irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex ``` [Download the Windows installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/install/windows.md) · [AMD ROCm](docs/install/windows-rocm.md)
Windows on ARM · experimental Native app UI; the x64 Python backend runs under emulation on the CPU. [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/install/windows.md)
Linux · AUR · Snap · DEB · AppImage · Nix
**Stable · x64**
Linux x64 · NVIDIA CUDA · CPU · Vulkan for supported GGUF engines.
One-command installer ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ```
Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS · AUR ```sh yay -S voicestudio-bin ``` Also available through `paru -S voicestudio-bin`. [Development sources](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/voicestudio-git) · `yay -S voicestudio-git`
Build from AUR and install with pacman ```sh sudo pacman -S --needed base-devel git git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/voicestudio-bin.git cd voicestudio-bin makepkg -s sudo pacman -U ./voicestudio-bin-*.pkg.tar.zst ```
Ubuntu / Debian / Linux Mint · DEB Download the `.deb` into the current folder, then install it: [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) ```sh sudo apt install ./VoiceStudio-*-linux-x64.deb ```
Snap · Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE and more With [snapd installed](https://snapcraft.io/docs/installing-snapd): ```sh sudo snap install voicestudio ``` To enable microphone access: ```sh sudo snap connect voicestudio:audio-record ```
Any Linux distribution · AppImage Download the AppImage into the current folder, then launch it: [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) ```sh chmod +x VoiceStudio-*-linux-x64.AppImage ./VoiceStudio-*-linux-x64.AppImage ```
Nix / NixOS · source environment Enter the repository’s FHS development environment, then run from source: ```sh git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio nix develop .#fhs bun run dev ``` [Guide](docs/install/nix.md)
[Guide](docs/install/linux.md)
Docker · GHCR · Docker Hub
Stable images · CPU · NVIDIA CUDA · AMD ROCm. **Run locally on the CPU (Bash)** ```sh export OMNIVOICE_API_KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" docker run -d --name omnivoice \ -p 127.0.0.1:3900:3900 \ -e OMNIVOICE_API_KEY \ -e OMNIVOICE_DATA_DIR=/app/omnivoice_data \ -v omnivoice-data:/app/omnivoice_data \ ghcr.io/debpalash/voicestudio:stable printf 'API key: %s\n' "$OMNIVOICE_API_KEY" ``` Open http://localhost:3900 and use the API key printed below. [NVIDIA, AMD ROCm and Compose instructions](docs/install/docker.md) [Docker Hub mirror](https://hub.docker.com/r/palashdeb/omnivoice-studio): `palashdeb/omnivoice-studio:stable`
Android · APK · Obtainium · F-Droid repository
Android 10+ · Preview · On-device, offline after model download. [Download APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/mobile.md#install)
F-Droid · VoiceStudio repository Add this repository in an F-Droid-compatible client; verify the fingerprint in the guide. ```text https://debpalash.github.io/VoiceStudio/fdroid/repo ``` [Guide](store/fdroid/README.md)
Obtainium · GitHub releases Add this source in Obtainium, or import the provided configuration. ```text https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio ``` [Import configuration](https://debpalash.github.io/VoiceStudio/obtainium.json)
Install over USB with adb ```sh adb install -r VoiceStudio-*-android.apk ```
iPhone / iPad · IPA · sideloading
iOS / iPadOS 17+ · Preview · On-device, offline after model download. Download the IPA and follow the signing and sideloading instructions. [Download](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest) · [Guide](docs/mobile.md#install)
Desktop and phone installers are on the [latest release](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest); Docker images come from GHCR. No GPU? The app is fully usable on the CPU, just slower. Native GGUF engines can also use Vulkan on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs; OmniVoice GGUF picks its GPU and model size automatically on Windows and Linux ([OmniVoice](docs/engines/omnivoice-gguf.md#vulkan-acceleration), [CosyVoice](docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)). Speed by engine and hardware: [performance](docs/performance.md). ## Get started Install using the options above. Then open **Voice cloning**, pick a voice or add a clean reference recording, type your text and generate. The app asks before it downloads any model.
More install options: a specific version, current main, uninstall, from source, with a coding agent ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # a specific release curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # build current main curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall # remove the app, keep your data ``` If `voicestudio.sh` is unreachable, run the script straight from the repository: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`. ## Introduction

AutoCAD is a powerful design and drafting software tailored for professionals in various fields such as architecture, engineering, and construction. It addresses the need for precise technical drawings and models, allowing users to create detailed plans efficiently. With its intuitive interface and robust toolset, AutoCAD simplifies complex design tasks, making it an essential tool for anyone involved in creating 2D and 3D designs.

Users can expect a comprehensive suite of features that streamline the design process, including advanced drafting tools, customizable templates, and collaboration capabilities. AutoCAD enables users to produce high-quality drawings and models, ensuring accuracy and saving time in project workflows. The software is built to enhance productivity and foster creativity, making it an indispensable asset for professionals who demand precision and reliability in their work.

AutoCAD has evolved significantly over the years, integrating innovative technologies to meet the changing needs of its users. Whether you are creating simple layouts or complex architectural designs, AutoCAD provides the tools necessary to bring your visions to life. Its extensive capabilities make it suitable for a wide range of applications, from civil engineering projects to interior design.

---

## Features

- **Advanced Drafting Tools**: AutoCAD offers a variety of drafting tools that allow for precise and efficient drawing creation. These tools include line, polyline, arc, circle, and more, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced users.

- **3D Modeling Capabilities**: Users can create and manipulate 3D models, providing a realistic view of their designs. Features like 3D solid modeling, surface modeling, and mesh modeling enable detailed representations of objects, allowing for better visualization of projects.

- **Customizable Templates**: With customizable templates, users can save time by setting up their workspace to fit specific project needs. This feature enhances workflow efficiency by allowing users to start with pre-defined layouts that suit their requirements.

- **Annotation Tools**: AutoCAD provides powerful annotation tools that help users add notes, dimensions, and other essential information directly onto their drawings. This feature enhances clarity and precision, ensuring that all necessary details are included.

- **Layer Management**: Users can organize their drawings using layers, which simplifies the management of complex designs. Layer management allows users to control the visibility and editing of various elements, making it easier to navigate and modify designs.

- **Cloud Integration**: AutoCAD offers cloud storage options, allowing users to save and access their projects online. This facilitates remote work and easy sharing, enabling users to collaborate effectively regardless of their location.

- **Performance Optimization**: The software is designed to run efficiently on supported systems, ensuring smooth operation even with large files and complex drawings. Features like hardware acceleration help improve performance during intensive tasks.

---

Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the setup. During the installation, you may be prompted to sign in or create an Autodesk account for activation purposes.

2. **Workspace Setup**: Once installed, users can customize their workspace by selecting templates and setting up their preferred toolbars to fit their workflow. The workspace can be arranged to include frequently used tools and commands, making it easier to access essential features.

3. **Creating Designs**: Start using the drawing tools to create 2D and 3D designs. Users can leverage the extensive library of shapes and components to enhance their projects. For instance, when designing a building layout, users can drag and drop pre-defined symbols for doors, windows, and furniture to speed up the process.

4. **Collaboration and Exporting**: After completing the design, users can collaborate with team members using the sharing features. You can publish your drawings to the cloud or share them via email. Additionally, export the final drawings in various file formats, such as DWG or PDF, for presentation or further use.

5. **Utilizing Advanced Features**: Explore advanced features like dynamic blocks, parametric constraints, and 3D printing capabilities to maximize efficiency. These features help automate repetitive tasks and ensure designs are adaptable to changes.

---

## Compatibility

**Hardware Requirements**

For example, complex 3D modeling may experience lag on lower-end systems. It is important to monitor system performance and consider upgrades if necessary.

---

## FAQ

### What is AutoCAD used for?  
AutoCAD is primarily used for creating detailed 2D and 3D drawings and models in various fields such as architecture, engineering, and construction. It helps professionals design, visualize, and communicate their ideas effectively, making it a crucial tool in technical design workflows.

Ensure your system meets the necessary requirements for a smooth installation process. You may need administrative privileges to complete the installation.

Yes, AutoCAD is designed to be compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems. Users should ensure their systems are updated and meet any other software requirements for optimal performance. It is recommended to check for Windows updates and drivers to ensure compatibility.

### Can I collaborate with others using AutoCAD?  
Yes, AutoCAD includes collaboration tools that allow multiple users to work on the same project simultaneously. This feature enables team members to share feedback and updates in real time, enhancing project communication. Utilizing the cloud storage feature further simplifies collaboration by allowing easy access to shared projects.

If you experience issues with AutoCAD, first check for software updates and ensure your system meets the necessary requirements. If problems persist, consult the official support resources or community forums for troubleshooting tips and assistance. ![claude-bughunter banner](assets/banner-v2.svg) # claude-bughunter > A self-contained Claude skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work · **84 skills** · 15 slash commands · **681 disclosed-report patterns** (433 now individually cited & auditable) across 24 core vulnerability classes · enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices · engagement-folder scaffolding · Burp MCP integration · battle-tested across authorized red-team and bug-hunting engagements, plus public training platforms (DVWA, OWASP Juice Shop, Hacker101, testphp.vulnweb.com). Built by **[Sachin Sharma](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sachinsharma8080/)** — Bug Hunting & GenAI Security Research.

SPONSORED BY

      

--- ## What is this? `claude-bughunter` is a drop-in skill bundle for the [Claude Code skills system](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills). Install once and Claude Code stops being a chatbot and starts behaving like a senior bug-hunting researcher or red-team operator: it knows the techniques, the chain templates, the VRT mappings, the platform CVE chains, and the hygiene — and it stays in scope. Four layers stack: - **Think** — `bb-methodology` + `redteam-mindset`: the 5-phase non-linear workflow, critical-thinking framework, and red-team operator discipline. - **Hunt webapps** — 58 `hunt-*` skills curated from 681 disclosed HackerOne reports: per-class detection patterns, payloads, bypass tables, and chain templates. - **Hit the perimeter** — enterprise platform chains (M365/Entra, Okta, vCenter, SSL-VPN appliances, SharePoint, cloud IAM): current 2024–2026 CVE chains + post-credential escalation. - **Ship it** — `triage-validation` + reporting + `evidence-hygiene`: the 7-Question Gate, VRT-aware severity, OOS rebuttals, PII redaction, and red-team deliverables. All triggered automatically by topic — describe what you're testing in plain English and the relevant skill loads. No invocation by name. --- ## Quickstart **Option A — install as a Claude Code plugin (recommended).** From inside Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter /plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsouls ``` All 84 skills + 15 commands load namespaced under `claude-bughunter:` and update when you bump the plugin version — no files copied into `~/.claude/`. **A HackerOne account is optional.** The install asks for a HackerOne API username and token. They only let the HackerOne MCP read your private programs and your own reports; leave both blank if you don't need that. Every skill, command and the MCP's public tools (duplicate search, program scope) work without them. **Option B — copy install (no plugin system / pin to a clone):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.git cd Claude-BugHunter ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux bash scripts/install.sh # Windows (PowerShell) pwsh ./scripts/install.ps1 ``` Both copy the skills + commands into `~/.claude/` (macOS/Linux) or `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\` (Windows) and wire the `hunt` engagement scaffolder. **What each install path gives you:** | Path | 84 skills + 15 slash commands | `cbh` CLI | `hunt` scaffolder | |---|---|---|---| | **A — plugin** | ✅ namespaced under `claude-bughunter:` | ➕ separate `pipx install` | ❌ clone-only | | **B — copy install** | ✅ copied into `~/.claude/` | ✅ from the clone | ✅ from the clone | The plugin is the fastest path to the skills + slash commands. The terminal-native `cbh` runner installs standalone — `pipx install git+https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter` — so plugin users can add it without a full clone (see [`cbh` CLI](docs/cbh-cli.md)). The `hunt` engagement scaffolder ships with the clone (Option B). That's it. Open Claude Code and describe what you're testing in plain English — the right skill loads automatically, no invocation by name: ```text > Testing acme.com — an in-scope HackerOne target. Run recon and rank the surface. ⟳ loading skills: web2-recon, offensive-osint, bb-methodology … → subdomain enum (subfinder + crt.sh) … 47 hosts → live hosts (httpx) … 12 · tech fingerprint … 6 distinct stacks → ranked surface: api.acme.com (GraphQL, introspection ON) ← start here auth.acme.com (OAuth, SSO) ← hunt-oauth Next: want me to probe the GraphQL introspection + OAuth redirect_uri? ``` → Full [Installation guide](INSTALL.md) · [Usage guide](USAGE.md) · [searchable skill catalog](docs/skills.md). > The block above is an illustrative transcript. To record a real demo of your own session: `asciinema rec demo.cast` → upload to [asciinema.org](https://asciinema.org) and drop the badge here. --- ## Runs on multiple agent harnesses ![One install, agent harnesses — Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, Google AntiGravity](assets/harness-routing.svg) The skills are plain [Agent Skills](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills) — the same `SKILL.md` format that **Claude Code · OpenCode · OpenAI Codex CLI · Hermes Agent · Google AntiGravity** all load. One command installs them everywhere: ```bash # macOS / Linux bash scripts/install.sh --all --burp-mcp # Windows (PowerShell) pwsh ./scripts/install.ps1 -All -BurpMcp ``` | Harness | Target Skill Directory | Flag | |---|---|---| | **Claude Code** (baseline) | `~/.claude/skills/` | *(default)* | | **OpenCode** | reads `~/.claude/skills/` & `~/.agents/skills/` | *(default)* / `--agents` | | **OpenAI Codex CLI** | `~/.agents/skills/` | `--agents` | | **Hermes Agent** | `~/.hermes/skills/` | `--hermes` | | **Google AntiGravity** | `~/.gemini/config/skills/` | `--antigravity` | `--all` (`-All`) detects installed harnesses and copies skills to each harness's path (`~/.claude/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.hermes/skills`, `~/.gemini/config/skills`); `--burp-mcp` (`-BurpMcp`) wires the Burp MCP server into each. The full *knowledge* layer ports to all five — the slash commands and `/hunt` engine stay Claude-Code-only by design. → [Multi-harness guide](docs/multi-harness.md) --- ## Star History Chart is self-hosted — regenerate with `python3 scripts/gen_star_history.py` (needs `gh auth login`). Refreshes automatically each day via `.github/workflows/star-history.yml`. --- ## Scope — what this bundle is for, and what it isn't This bundle covers the **external attack surface** — anything reachable from the internet without first compromising an internal endpoint. ### In scope - **Bug bounty hunting** — web apps, APIs, SaaS, GraphQL, OAuth, JWT, file upload, IDOR, SSRF, RCE chains - **Web application pentesting** — full hunt-* coverage of OWASP-mapped bug classes + discipline rules - **External red-team engagements** — initial-access against internet-facing enterprise estate: M365 / Entra ID, Okta-as-IdP, SharePoint on-prem (ToolShell + legacy SOAP), VMware vCenter / Workspace ONE, SSL VPN appliances (Cisco / Fortinet / Citrix / Palo Alto / Pulse / SonicWall / F5), Android APK red-team, supply-chain recon - **Cloud misconfig + post-credential escalation** — public S3, IMDS chains, STS AssumeRole, cross-account confused-deputy - **Recon + OSINT** — subdomain enum, identity-fabric mapping, certificate transparency, JS analysis, secret scanning - **Reporting** — H1, Bugcrowd (VRT-aware), Intigriti, Immunefi, plus client-facing red-team deliverable format ### Out of scope (deliberate — not gaps, design decisions) - **Internal Active Directory attacks** — BloodHound, Kerberoasting, ASREProast, DCSync, Pass-the-Hash, AD CS abuse, ntlmrelayx, Responder, PetitPotam, etc. Different operational risk profile; needs different tooling and judgment. **Future bundle, not this one.** - **C2 frameworks** — Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mythic, Havoc, BRC4 tradecraft. Out of scope for external-only engagement model. - **Post-exploit / persistence / lateral** — Mimikatz/comsvcs LSASS dumping, golden/silver tickets, named-pipe impersonation, persistence (registry, scheduled tasks, WMI events, COM hijacking), token theft. These start after the perimeter has already broken — different bundle territory. - **Evasion** — AMSI bypass, ETW patching, AV/EDR bypass. Tied to C2 tradecraft above. - **iOS pentesting / hardware / RF / ICS** — out of scope by design. - **Binary exploitation / kernel pwn / browser internals** — different skill universe. If you're running an internal red team that includes domain-takeover chains via Kerberos or lateral movement, **this bundle won't help you in those phases** — and we'd rather say that up front than have you find out mid-engagement. The external surface handoff to internal-RT tooling (Impacket, NetExec, CrackMapExec, Rubeus, Certify, BloodHound) is intentionally outside our scope. **Coverage for internal AD and post-exploit may come in a future update.** --- ## What's inside **84 skills**, auto-loaded by topic — no invocation by name. Coverage across the external attack surface: | Category | # | Examples | |---|---|---| | Hunt — web app vuln classes | 58 | XSS, SQLi, SSRF, IDOR, LFI, SSTI, XXE, CSRF, CORS, open-redirect, SharePoint, ASP.NET/NTLM | | Enterprise platform attack ★ | 10 | M365/Entra, Okta, cloud-IAM-deep, vCenter, enterprise VPN, APK/iOS red-team pipelines, supply-chain recon | | Reporting & validation | 7 | triage-validation, evidence-hygiene, report-writing, bugcrowd-reporting | | Recon & OSINT | 5 | web2-recon, offensive-osint, osint-methodology, recon-scope-triage | | Methodology & mindset | 4 | bb-methodology, bug-bounty, redteam-mindset, bb-local-toolkit | Full searchable catalog → **[docs/skills.md](docs/skills.md)**. Also ships **15 slash commands** (`/hunt`, `/recon`, `/report`, …) and a deterministic **engagement engine** (`engine/`) that maps a target's attack surface and routes each finding to the skill that handles it. --- ## How it works A 6-phase, non-linear workflow — **recon → map & rank → hunt → validate → report** — with scope enforced in code and a **7-Question Gate** before anything is submitted. Two ways to drive it: - **Plain English** — describe what you're testing and the relevant skill loads automatically. - **`/hunt` scaffold + `cbh` CLI** — engagement-folder structure, state, and orchestration. → [Usage guide & worked example](USAGE.md) · [6-phase architecture & skill-to-phase map](docs/architecture.md) · [`cbh` CLI](docs/cbh-cli.md) --- ## Authorization These skills are intended for assets you **own** or have **written authorization to assess** (bug-bounty in-scope assets, pentest engagement letters, CTF challenges, your own infrastructure). The skills include validation gates that auto-trigger when you point Claude at unverified third-party targets — `triage-validation`'s 7-Question Gate explicitly asks whether the asset is in scope (Q3) and on the program's accepted-impact list (Q2). The `bugcrowd-reporting` skill includes researcher-side hygiene (Bugcrowdninja alias, account-state restoration, friendly-tester posture) that signals legitimate authorized testing to the target's fraud team. The bundle explicitly **excludes**: weaponizing 0-days against unauthorized targets, post-exploitation tooling, malware development, mass-targeting infrastructure. See [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) for the full posture. > **Heads-up — Anthropic runtime cyber safeguards.** Anthropic's models apply real-time safeguards that **block "vulnerability exploitation or offensive security tooling development" by default** — so even *authorized, in-scope* work can hit a refusal that isn't this bundle's doing. If you do authorized offensive security (pentest / bug bounty / red team), enroll in Anthropic's **free, application-based [Cyber Verification Program (CVP)](https://claude.com/form/cyber-use-case)** to get safeguards adjusted for legitimate dual-use work. (Mass data exfiltration and ransomware development stay prohibited and are *not* adjustable.) Details: [Anthropic — real-time cyber safeguards](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-real-time-cyber-safeguards-on-claude). ### Why your model switched mid-session Separate from refusals, and easy to miss. On **Opus 5**, a narrow set of higher-risk cyber requests — Anthropic names *exploit generation*, *binary-based vulnerability scanning* and *penetration testing* — **fall back to Opus 4.8** rather than being refused. You get a notice and the response is labelled with the model that answered, but in a long agentic run that is easy to scroll past, so it can look like Opus 5 quietly got worse. See [why Claude switched models](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16049681-why-claude-switched-models-in-your-conversation-with-opus-5). What to do depends on what you are actually doing: | Situation | What helps | |---|---| | **Auditing your own code** — reviewing a repo you own for defects | Say so. "Defensive review of my own repo", "check this against the OWASP Top 10", "secure refactor to remediate" describe the work accurately and read as remediation. This is not a workaround; the work genuinely is defensive. | | **Authorized offensive work** — live engagement, PoC for a bounty submission | This is what the bundle is for, and the supported route is [CVP](https://claude.com/form/cyber-use-case). Do not reword an offensive engagement to look defensive to get past a classifier — enroll instead. | | **You just want the switching off** | Settings → Capabilities disables automatic model switching. | `/hunt` states the engagement frame (authorized, scope-bounded, remediable finding) on its first turn for exactly this reason — engagement context belongs in the session explicitly, not implied. --- ## Documentation | Doc | Contents | |---|---| | [`README.md`](README.md) | This file — overview, quickstart, scope, skill summary | | [`INSTALL.md`](INSTALL.md) | Full setup with Burp MCP integration and optional skill regenerator | | [`USAGE.md`](USAGE.md) | Workflow walkthrough · decision tree · worked engagement example | | [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) | 6-phase architecture · skill-to-phase mapping · engagement composition | | [`docs/cbh-cli.md`](docs/cbh-cli.md) | `cbh` CLI — native runner orchestrating recon + classify + triage + report | | [`docs/cve-coverage.md`](docs/cve-coverage.md) | CISA KEV coverage snapshot — refreshed weekly via the workflow template at `docs/automation/cve-refresh.yml.template` | | [`docs/credits.md`](docs/credits.md) | Full attribution: 43 original skills + 8 vendored from upstream | | [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) | PR guidelines · skill quality standards · scope | | [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) | Authorized-use posture · responsible disclosure · what's excluded | | [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) | MIT | | [`NOTICE`](NOTICE) | Upstream-skills attribution · no-redistribution note | | [`LICENSE-CONTENT`](LICENSE-CONTENT) | CC BY 4.0 (skill methodology, wordlists, docs) | --- ## Why this exists Most bug-hunting Claude setups are either too generic (one big "security" prompt) or too fragmented (you bookmark 30 disclosed reports and re-read them every engagement). This bundle was built and validated through authorized engagements that exposed different capability gaps: **Bug-bounty engagement** — surfaced four gaps a starter 3-skill stack could not close: 1. **No hypothesis discipline** — drafts written before validation → wasted hours, hurt validity ratio 2. **No per-program reporting tactics** — VRT defaults auto-downgraded P3-worthy findings to P4 3. **No engagement coordination** — findings, evidence, and submission IDs scattered across folders 4. **No evidence hygiene** — screenshots leaked cookies and victim PII **External red-team engagement** — exposed five additional gaps that bug-bounty defaults made worse: 1. **Conservative defaults retracted real findings** — WAPT mindset stopped tests early on defended targets where red-team continuation would have surfaced bypass chains → `redteam-mindset` 2. **No mid-engagement situational awareness** — client SOC patched confirmed SQLi within 30 min; ## 这是什么

原站是ギア（@giaaibusi）发布的三大 AI 绘画参考图库（姿势、服装、人像），元数据全部为日文，且分散在三个独立站点。本仓库（v2.0）完成了**三站合一、全量中文化、AI 角色合成工作台与 ComfyUI 原生插件升级**：

3. **三合一 AI 角色合成工作台（Web Studio）** —— 基于 **React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript 7 + shadcn/ui + TanStack Router** 构建的响应式多页面应用（兼容 PC / 平板 / 手机）：
   - 从三大图库任意挑选 **人像 + 服装 + 姿势（支持素体白模 / 深度图一键切换）** 组合配方，或一键随机捏人；
   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点（姿势与配方节点内置 `use_depth` 深度图切换，可直接接入 ControlNet Depth）与内置的 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式、卡片内多角度切换，以及 **`[ 素体白模 | 深度图 (Depth) ]` 一键切换预览与下载**。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势，姿势槽位内置 `[ 白模 | 深度 ]` 实时切换）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：
  - **Google Gemini**：`gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`、`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image`（支持宽高比 `aspectRatio`、分辨率 `1K/2K/4K`）
  - **OpenAI GPT Image**：`gpt-image-2.5`、`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-1.5`、`gpt-image-1`（支持 `/v1/images/edits` JSON URL 直传 / Multipart 上传、尺寸、质量、背景透明度）
  - **阿里云百炼 Qwen**：`qwen-image-3.0-pro`、`qwen-image-2.1-pro`、`qwen-image-2.0-pro`、`qwen-image-edit-plus`（支持 `multimodal-generation` 多图参考输入、智能改写 `prompt_extend`、水印开关）
  - **字节火山方舟 Doubao**：`doubao-seedream-5-0`、`doubao-seedream-4-5-251128`、`doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`、`doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628`（支持多图融合 `image: [...]`、2K/4K 分辨率）
  - **本地 ComfyUI 工作流引擎**：支持自动将三合一拼图及单张人像/服装/姿势图上传至本地 ComfyUI（`/upload/image`），注入自定义 API 工作流占位符或自动识别节点提交 `/prompt` 队列并轮询取回成品图；支持导入/导出通用 `.api.json` 工作流模板。
- **跨页面后台生图 & IndexedDB 历史记录**：切换页面不会中断正在进行的生图请求；生成结果自动存入浏览器 IndexedDB（避免 `localStorage` 容量限制），支持复用提示词与原图下载。

> 本地 ComfyUI 三图合成（Qwen Image Edit 2509）的模型清单、工作流说明和本地运行方法见 [docs/comfyui-local.md](docs/comfyui-local.md)。

> 导入 API 后的动态高级参数、设定集参考上传与可选显示声明见 [ComfyUI 工作流高级参数](docs/comfyui-workflow-parameters.md)。

> WebSocket 实时进度、HTTP 保底与刷新恢复见 [ComfyUI 任务连接与恢复](docs/comfyui-task-tracking.md)。

### 3. ComfyUI 原生自定义节点插件（`comfyui_plugin/`）
将本仓库克隆到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ai-pose-gallery-zh` 后，ComfyUI 画布右键菜单 **「AI角色三合一参考图集」** 下自动提供 4 个节点：
- **AI 姿势参考图 (`PoseGalleryNode`)**：输出 `姿势图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`姿势提示词`（支持 `use_depth` 开关一键切换输出素体白模或深度图）
- **AI 服装参考图 (`CostumeGalleryNode`)**：输出 `服装图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`中文服装描述`、`英文服装Prompt`
- **AI 人像参考图 (`PortraitGalleryNode`)**：输出 `人像图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`人像发型描述`
- **AI 角色三合一合成配方 (`CharacterRecipeNode`)**：单节点同时输出 `人像图`、`服装图`、`姿势图（支持 use_depth 深度图切换）`、`三合一拼图` 以及自动组装的 `中文合成Prompt` 与 `英文合成Prompt`，并内置 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器（含 🌗 深度图预览开关）**与节点内实时缩略图预览。


### 4. 界面语言：中文（默认）/ English / ไทย
- 页面右上角的国旗按钮可切换 **中文 / English / ไทย**，选择会保存在浏览器 `localStorage`；首次访问按浏览器语言自动选择（`th*` → 泰文，`en*` → 英文，其余一律中文）。
- 中文为默认语言且数据不变：英文 / 泰文只是附加的显示层，界面文案在 `src/i18n/locales/`，数据标签（姿势名称、服装名称、分类、标签、发型等）在 `data/i18n/<lang>/`，按原有 id 索引；未翻译的内容自动回退为中文。
- 发送给图像模型的提示词始终使用原始数据，与界面语言无关；安全模式（SFW）规则不变。

## 在 ComfyUI 中使用（双模式支持）

### 模式 A：作为 ComfyUI 原生插件安装（在 ComfyUI 画布内选图）

无需安装额外 Python 依赖（直接复用 ComfyUI 自带的 `torch`、`numpy`、`Pillow`、`aiohttp`）：

```bash
cd /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh.git
```

重启 ComfyUI 后：
1. 在画布空白处右键 → **新建节点** → **AI角色三合一参考图集**；
2. 选择 **「AI 角色三合一合成配方 (3-in-1 Recipe)」** 或单个姿势 / 服装 / 人像节点；
3. 点击节点上的 **「🎨 打开三合一选图器 (6,162张)」** 按钮（或直接点击节点上的缩略图），即可在弹窗中按分类、视角、发长筛选或中文搜索，一键填入节点并输出 `IMAGE` 张量与中英文 Prompt。

### 模式 B：从 Web 合成台直连本地 ComfyUI API

如果您使用线上网页端（或本地 `pnpm dev`）选图，希望直接调用本机 ComfyUI 生图：
1. 启动本地 ComfyUI 时开启跨域参数：
   ```bash
   python main.py --enable-cors-header "*"
   ```
2. 打开本工作台 **「接口配置」** 页面 → 切换到 **「本地 ComfyUI」** → 点击「检测连接」（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8188`）；
3. 可直接导入您在 ComfyUI 中通过 `工作流 -> 导出 (API)` 保存的 `.json` 文件（支持 `{{prompt}}`、`{{seed}}`、`{{width}}`、`{{height}}`、`{{composite_image}}`、`{{portrait_image}}`、`{{costume_image}}`、`{{pose_image}}` 占位符，或由系统自动匹配 `CLIPTextEncode` / `KSampler` / `LoadImage` 节点），也可在 **「合成台」** 一键导出内置通用工作流模板。

## 技术栈与目录结构

## 本地开发与构建

需要 **Node.js 20+** 与 **pnpm**：

```bash
# 1. 安装依赖
pnpm install

# 2. 启动本地开发服务器（默认 http://localhost:5173）
pnpm dev

# 3. 类型检查 + 生产构建 + 代码规范检查
pnpm build && pnpm lint
```

### 数据与图片维护脚本（Python 3）

```bash
# 拉取/补全三站图片（已存在的文件自动跳过，支持断点续传）
python3 scripts/download.py
WORKERS=64 python3 scripts/download.py   # 调整并发线程数

# 修改 scripts/i18n.py 词典后，重新生成三库中文 JSON
python3 scripts/apply_translation.py

# 校验全部图片文件是否完整
python3 scripts/verify.py
```

## 部署到 Cloudflare（Workers / Pages）

本项目自带 [wrangler.jsonc](wrangler.jsonc) 与 [worker.ts](worker.ts)，同时支持 **Cloudflare Workers（含静态 Assets + `/api/proxy` 同源代理）** 与 **Cloudflare Pages** 部署。仓库总体积约 `1.1 GB`、总文件数约 `11,600` 个、单文件全部 `< 2 MB`，完全符合 Cloudflare 免费版限制（单文件 ≤ 25 MiB，文件数 ≤ 20,000）。

> 💡 **自定义代理域名白名单（可选）**：`/api/proxy` 默认放行五大官方 AI 接口域名，并在切换至阿里云百炼（Qwen）或火山方舟（Doubao）时自动开启。若需通过服务端代理转发自定义中转站，可在 Cloudflare 环境变量或 `wrangler.jsonc` 的 `vars.PROXY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` 中配置逗号分隔的来源白名单（支持精确域名与泛子域名，如 `https://api.example.com,https://*.openai.com`）。

### 方式一：Cloudflare Workers 自动/命令行部署（推荐，内置 `/api/proxy` 解决千问/豆包跨域）

```bash
# 1. 构建前端与静态资源目录 dist/
bash scripts/build.sh

# 2. 本地或预览环境验证
npx wrangler versions upload

# 3. 正式部署到 Cloudflare Workers
npx wrangler deploy
```

若使用 Cloudflare Dashboard 连接 GitHub 自动构建 Workers：
- **Build command**：`bash scripts/build.sh`
- **Deploy command**：`npx wrangler deploy`

### 方式二：Cloudflare Pages 部署

1. 登录 Cloudflare Dashboard → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → **Pages** → **Connect to Git**
2. 选择本仓库 → 生产分支 `main`
3. 构建设置：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Framework preset | `None`（或 `Vite`） |
   | Build command | `bash scripts/build.sh` |
   | Build output directory | `dist` |

## Agent 技能（Skills）

`skills/` 下提供 9 个 `SKILL.md` 格式的 Agent 技能，让 AI Agent 检索姿势、服装、人像参考。原有技能的 `references/catalog.csv` 用**相对路径**（`../../img/…`）指向本仓库 `img/`；二次元技能使用原站URL，不重复存图：

| 技能 | 图片数 | 范围 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `pose-reference-standard` | 365 | 全身单人・标准系 |
| `pose-reference-upper` | 400 | 上半身单人 |
| `pose-reference-sexy` | 399 | 全身单人・性感系（18+） |
| `pose-reference-couple` | 275 | 双人缠绵（18+） |
| `pose-reference-all` | 1,439 | 全部姿势 |
| `costume-reference` | 1,068 | 服装：春夏秋冬・派对礼服・泳装度假（按单品 / 颜色 / 英文关键词检索） |
| `costume-reference-anime` | 440 | CharaDB 二次元服装，联网参考图，独立来源限制 |
| `costume-reference-sexy` | 339 | 服装：内衣睡衣・性感穿搭（18+） |
| `portrait-reference` | 1,499 | 人像：正脸参考・造型氛围，按发长 / 51 种发型检索 |

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh.git ~/ai-pose-gallery-zh
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
for d in ~/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/*-reference*; do ln -s "$d" ~/.claude/skills/; done
```

原有技能靠相对路径读取 `img/`，请**软链**而不是复制，并保留整个仓库。`costume-reference-anime` 使用原站URL，不保存图片，且适用独立来源限制。组合参考时须分别遵守各来源条件。
